hero.title: Three dentists, *one familiar office*
hero.lede: Dr. Kevin Eubanks, Dr. Trent Yoder and Dr. Matthew Wall practice general dentistry together at 174 Crepe Myrtle Drive.

sections.title: Also known as *Drs. Eubanks & Yoder*
body: Southern Dental Associates is a general dental practice on Crepe Myrtle Drive in Aiken. Some patients know it by its other name, Drs. Eubanks & Yoder, and listings give both.
Patients mention a friendly staff, easy scheduling and a dentist who works to keep them comfortable.

items.q: Is Southern Dental Associates the same office as Drs. Eubanks & Yoder?
items.a: Yes. Both names belong to the practice at 174 Crepe Myrtle Drive, phone (803) 641-3883.
Listings show Delta Dental PPO and Delta Dental Premier. Call with your plan's name to check it.
Call the office and ask which dentist has openings.

sections.title: Due for a visit?
sections.text: Call the office on Crepe Myrtle Drive.

before: No website of its own: a search turns up directory pages under two different names
Hours and new-patient status differ from one directory to the next
The first thing a new patient sees is not something the practice controls
after: A site the practice owns, under the name it chooses
Hours, phone, address and map in one obvious place
Each dentist introduced in the practice's own words
Room for insurance plans and new-patient forms as the office supplies them
